mapper.select: SELECT profile_id, party_id, approved_time, draft_application_id, content_hash FROM t_party_profile WHERE profile_id IN (SELECT party_profile_id FROM t_agreement_party WHERE agreement_id IN (SELECT agreement_id FROM t_agreement WHERE client_id = #{clientId} OR (local_partner_id IN (SELECT source_partner_id FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type='PARTNER') AND agreement_id IN (SELECT agreement_id FROM t_agreement_operating_entity WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}))))) OR party_id IN (SELECT party_id FROM t_client WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) ORDER BY profile_id
